desc: Add a volatility regime filter: only enter long positions when current realized volatility is below the volatility target.
Add a trend filter: only enter long when price is above the 50-day SMA and the SMA is rising (above its prior value).
Add a volume confirmation filter: only enter long when current volume exceeds 1.2 times the 20-day average volume.
Add an ADX trend filter: only enter long when the 14‑bar ADX exceeds 20, ensuring entries occur in trending markets.
Change exit condition from Donchian low to close below 10-day SMA
Add a long-term trend filter: only enter long when price is above the 200-day simple moving average.
